terms: These terms govern your use of the Bricks app. By creating an account or using the app, you agree to them. If you do not agree, do not use the app.
Questions: brett@bricksslc.com
1. Who can use the app

The Bricks app is for members of Bricks SLC and people applying to become members. You must be at least 18. You are responsible for what happens under your account and for keeping access to your phone number secure, since that is how you sign in.
2. Your membership and your app account are separate
Your Bricks membership is governed by your membership agreement with Bricks SLC. These terms cover the app only.
Deleting your app account does not cancel your membership or stop your billing, and cancelling your membership is handled by Bricks SLC directly. To end a membership, contact brett@bricksslc.com.
3. Community rules
Bricks is a working community sharing one building. The app is an extension of that building, and the same standards apply.
There is zero tolerance for objectionable content or abusive behaviour.
You agree not to post, send or upload anything that:
•    harasses, threatens, bullies, defames or intimidates another person;

•    is hateful or discriminatory toward anyone on the basis of race, ethnicity, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristic;
•    is sexually explicit or pornographic;
•    depicts or encourages violence, self-harm or illegal activity;
•    infringes anyone's copyright, trademark, privacy or other rights;
•    is spam, a scam, or an unsolicited commercial solicitation;
•    shares another member's private information without their permission;
•    impersonates another person; or
•    contains malware or attempts to breach the security of the app.
You also agree not to misuse the reporting tools — for example, by reporting content you simply disagree with.
4. Reporting, blocking and enforcement
Reporting. You can report any post, comment or message from the app. Reported content is hidden from you immediately, and the report goes to a Bricks administrator.
We review reports within 24 hours and take appropriate action, which may include removing the content, warning the member, or terminating their access to the app.

Blocking. You can block any member from their profile. Once blocked, neither of you sees the other's posts, comments or messages, and neither can message the other. You can unblock from Edit profile → Blocked members.

Our rights. We may remove any content and suspend or terminate any account that breaches these terms, with or without notice. Removing someone's app access does not by itself end their membership agreement, and ending a membership is handled separately.
5. Your content

You keep ownership of what you post. By posting it, you give Bricks SLC a non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to host, store, display and distribute it within the app so that the app can work — for example, showing your post in the feed to other members. This licence ends when you delete the content or your account, except for copies already made in routine backups.
You are responsible for what you post, and you confirm you have the right to post it.
6. Payments

Membership fees are charged under your membership agreement. Payments are processed by Stripe; Bricks never receives or stores your bank or card details. Fees, billing dates and cancellation terms are set by your membership agreement, not by these terms.
7. Availability

We work to keep the app running but do not guarantee it will always be available or error-free. We may change, suspend or discontinue features. The app is provided "as is" and "as available", without warranties of any kind to the extent the law allows.
8. Limitation of liability

To the fullest extent permitted by law, Bricks SLC is not liable for indirect, incidental, special or consequential damages arising from your use of the app. Nothing here limits liability that cannot be limited by law.
Bricks does not control what members post and is not responsible for content created by members, though we will act on reports as described above.
9. Governing law
These terms are governed by the laws of the State of Utah, without regard to its conflict-of-laws rules. Disputes will be brought in the state or federal courts located in Salt Lake County, Utah.
10. Changes
We may update these terms. If we make significant changes we will tell members in the app, and continuing to use the app after that means you accept the updated terms.
11. SMS Messaging

We send one time verification codes by text when you sign in. Message frequency varies. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out or HELP for help. No mobile information will be shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes. Text messaging opt-in data and consent will not be shared with any third parties.
Bricks SLC · Salt Lake City, Utah · brett@bricksslc.com
privacy: Bricks SLC ("Bricks", "we", "us") runs a members' workspace in Salt Lake City and the Bricks app for its members. This policy explains what the app collects, why, who else sees it, and what control you have.
Questions: brett@bricksslc.com
1. What we collect
Your account Phone number, email address, name, company name, bio, social handles, links, the clubs or interests you pick, your profile photo, your company logo, and your chosen profile backdrop.

Your membership Membership type and status, which company you belong to, whether you are a company's principal or a teammate, the date you signed your membership agreement, and whether you gave photo-release consent.
What you create in the app Posts, comments, likes, event RSVPs, direct and group messages, and any documents or images you upload.

Safety and moderation If you block another member, we record that. If you report a post, comment or message, we record the report — including who reported it, who wrote the reported content, and a copy of that content — so an administrator can review it. Reports are visible only to you and to Bricks administrators.
Payment Bank and card details are handled entirely by Stripe and never reach our servers or the app. We store only the Stripe identifiers that link your company to its subscription.

Your device The app asks for photo library and camera access only so you can choose or take a picture to post or use as a profile photo, and for write-only calendar access only when you choose to add a Bricks event to your calendar. It cannot read your calendar. We do not collect your location.
2. What we do not do

We do not use analytics, advertising or tracking software of any kind. There is none in the app. We do not track you across other apps or websites, we do not build advertising profiles, and we do not sell your personal information.
3. Why we use it

To give you access to the app and the workspace; to show you the member directory, feed, events and messages; to run your membership and billing; to arrange tours and meetings; to keep the community safe by acting on reports and blocks; and to contact you about your membership.
4. Who else sees it
We use these service providers. Each receives only what it needs.
[[providers]]
We may also disclose information if the law requires it, or to protect the safety, rights or property of members, staff or the public.

Other members see what you would expect them to see: your name, company, bio, photo, social handles and links in the member directory, and anything you post, comment or send. They do not see your phone number, email address, home address, billing details, or whether you have blocked or reported anyone.
5. Deleting your account
You can delete your Bricks app account at any time from Edit profile → Delete account. Deleting it permanently removes your profile, posts, comments, messages, likes and RSVPs. This cannot be undone.
Two things you should know.
Deleting your app account does not cancel your Bricks membership or your billing. They are separate. To end your membership, contact brett@bricksslc.com.

We keep one record after deletion. For financial and contractual record-keeping we retain your name, your company's Stripe identifiers, your membership type and the date of deletion. We keep nothing else — no phone number, email address, profile content or messages. We retain that record for as long as our tax and accounting obligations require.
Images you uploaded may remain in backup storage for a period after deletion while backups age out.
6. Your rights

You can view and correct most of your information in the app under Edit profile. You can delete your account as described above. You can block any member. Depending on where you live you may also have rights to a copy of your data, to correction or erasure, or to object to certain processing. To exercise any of these, email brett@bricksslc.com and we will respond within 30 days.
7. Security and location

Data is stored in the United States on Supabase's infrastructure. Access to member data is restricted by database-level security rules, and administrative access is limited to Bricks staff who need it. No system is perfectly secure, but we take reasonable measures to protect your information.
8. Children
The Bricks app is for members of Bricks SLC and is not intended for anyone under 18. We do not knowingly collect information from children.
9. Changes
If we change this policy we will update the date above and, for significant changes, tell members in the app.
10. Messaging

We send one time verification codes by text when you sign in. Message frequency varies. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out or HELP for help. No mobile information will be shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes. Text messaging opt-in data and consent will not be shared with any third parties.
